notes.title: A remake of《 APlaceDominatedByHoles》
notes.notes: This game was originally created using Unity. Recently, due to some issues, we decided to replace the engine and reset it. We are currently familiar with the new engine, and the current version of the game will stop updating. Later, we will bring a game version that has been reset by the new engine. At that time, we will find ways to add a startup interface for the old version to facilitate players who like the old screen. The good news is that the remake is expected to add 1-2 new endings. Stay tuned——

notes.title: Fixed bug
notes.notes: We have fixed the issue of item loss that most people have reported, but due to a change in the way the item was saved, the previous save will become invalid. Please note that if it is not automatically updated, please right-click on game properties ->Installed files ->Verify the integrity of the game files and update them directly
